The y-axis label is incorrectly described as 'Средни слънчеви дни (дни)' instead of 'Средни леглодни (дни)'.

The value for 2008 is incorrectly reported as 292 instead of approximately 270.
The value for 2012 is incorrectly reported as 274 instead of approximately 265.
The value for 2013 is incorrectly reported as a peak of 285 instead of a slight increase (no specific value given, but not a peak).
The value for 2017 is hallucinated; no data point is shown for 2017 in the figure for Graph A.
The value for 2021 is incorrectly reported as 195 instead of approximately 200.
The description omits mentioning the black markers on the red line for Graph A.
